title: TASTE: A Designer-Annotated Multi-Dimensional Preference Dataset for AI-Generated Graphic Design
abstract: arXiv:2605.20731v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-to-image models now generate graphic design at production scale, yet their supervision still comes primarily from photo-style preference datasets with a single overall verdict per comparison. Designers evaluate designs along several distinct axes (e.g., typography, layout, color harmony) that a single preference label collapses. We release \emph{TASTE} \textit{(Typography, Aesthetics, Spatial, Tone, Etc.)}, a multi-dimensional preference dataset in which two disjoint cohorts of five professional designers each ranked outputs from four current text-to-image models across nine criteria along with per-image hallucination flags. We pair the dataset with two contributions. translated_title: TASTE：一个由设计师标注的AI生成平面设计多维度偏好数据集
translated_abstract: 文生图模型现在已经能够以生产规模生成平面设计，然而其监督信号仍然主要来自照片风格的偏好数据集，每次比较只有一个总体评判。设计师会沿着多个不同的维度评估设计（例如排版、布局、色彩和谐度），而单一的偏好标签会将这些维度压缩在一起。我们发布了TASTE（Typography、Aesthetics、Spatial、Tone等），这是一个多维度偏好数据集，其中两组互不重叠的、各由五名专业设计师组成的团队对四个当前文生图模型的输出按照九项标准进行排序，并附有每张图像的幻觉标记。我们为该数据集配套了两项贡献。首先，一个与具体标准无关的信号验证框架，基于Kendall's τ、多数投票概率和Condorcet循环，并与精确的独立同分布均匀零假设进行对比；分析显示设计师之间的一致性显著但程度适中，TASTE的每一项标准都……
tldr: 该论文发布了TASTE——首个由专业设计师标注的AI生成平面设计多维度偏好数据集，涵盖排版、美学、空间、色调等九项评估标准并附幻觉标记，同时提出了基于Kendall's τ、多数投票概率和Condorcet循环的信号验证框架。
en_tdlr: This paper releases TASTE, a designer-annotated multi-dimensional preference dataset for AI-generated graphic design covering nine criteria (typography, aesthetics, spatial, tone, etc.) with hallucination flags, paired with a criterion-agnostic signal-validation framework based on Kendall's τ, majority-vote probability, and Condorcet cycles.
